final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders AS o JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE CAST(o.date_order_placed AS TEXT) > '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND CAST(o.date_order_placed AS TEXT) < '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender) SELECT gender, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM gender_counts) AS above_average FROM gender_counts WHERE order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM gender_counts)
